notes.title: Bye, bye!
notes.content:
I've a sad new for everyone who enjoyed Crunch Time!

Soon Crunch Time! won't be available anymore in Steam.

Thanks for all you feedback and I wish to see you in a future with Crunch Time 2! or another projects.

Thanks again
